title: 第26章 体内豢养神魔
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
秦然朝前方的血色炼狱走去。

    随着距离越来越近，那一道道仿佛来自于远古的惊悚气息越发强烈。

    耳畔隐隐响起陌生嘶吼！

    此地封存的血色光球并不算多，仅有四五十个，但每一个都血气浓烈。

    虽存在着无数岁月，却依旧散发着惊人余威……

    秦然一个个看过去。

    目光渐渐凝重。

    三首黑魔猿，六阶主宰境妖兽。

    九头枭，八阶主宰境妖兽。

    赤霄魔尊，七阶主宰境神魔。

    火穹灵神，主宰境巅峰神魔。

    秦然一眼看去，目之所及，血球中存放的，居然都是高阶主宰境神魔妖兽的精血。

    这质量，比皇家宝库中强的不是一星半点！

    他的目光朝深处望去。

    那里，血球中精血的气息更加狂暴浓烈……

    很快，一滴黑龙形态的黑色血液吸引了他的注意。

    黑渊古龙，准帝境妖兽！

    秦然目光一凝。

    “果然有准帝境精血。”

    继续往下看，他脸上的惊讶之色越来越浓。

    焚魃神尊，一阶准帝境神魔！

    圣焰龙雀，三阶准帝境神魔！

    蜗皇龙蟒，三阶准帝境妖兽！

    太古归墟，二阶准帝境神魔！

    “咦？居然还有圣焰龙雀一族精血？”

    秦然嘴角带着一丝恶趣味。

    “我若是在体内豢养一尊圣焰龙雀，待日后化身圣焰龙雀之时，焰妃的表情一定会很精彩吧？”

    这些准帝境神魔妖兽都是顶级血脉，无论选哪一个都是不错的选择。

    秦然将圣焰龙雀精血暂列为备选方案，若接下来没遇到合适的，那选择圣焰龙雀精血，也未尝不可。

    没准儿，还能借此将龙雀拉入己方阵营……

    准帝境神魔精血散发出的气息，已经压得人喘不上气来。

    秦然额头渐渐淌下汗珠。

    他目光越过准帝境神魔精血，望向了血色炼狱的最深处。

    那里，有三个血团呈品字形漂浮着。

    其内部各有一滴血液。

    三滴血液在血团内缓缓流动，仿佛蕴含着某种道韵，欲将人的灵魂都吸进去。

    秦然赶忙收回目光，惊起了一身冷汗。

    “不愧是帝族云家，居然还真收藏有大帝境神魔精血。”

    震惊过后，秦然难掩兴奋。

    他是小说作者没错，但设定云族始祖殿的时候，也仅是用底蕴深厚来简单形容，不可能将内部物品一件件列举出来。

    这三滴大帝境神魔精血，确实出乎了他的意料……

    黑虬天帝，一阶大帝境妖兽！

    虚无之主，一阶大帝境神魔！

    最后一个血团中散发着神秘耀眼的五色光，其气息比另外两个血团还要强上一大截。
content_en:
Qin Ran walked towards the bloody purgatory ahead.

    As the distance got closer and closer, the terrifying aura that seemed to come from ancient times became stronger and stronger.

    A strange roar sounded faintly in my ears!

    There are not many blood-colored light balls sealed here, only forty or fifty, but each one is full of blood.

    Although it has existed for countless years, it still exudes an astonishing residual power...

    Qin Ran looked at them one by one.

    His eyes gradually became serious.

    Three black demon apes, sixth level domination realm monsters.

    Nine-headed owl, an eighth-level domination realm monster.

    Chixiao Demon Lord, a seventh-level domination realm god and demon.

    Fire Dome Spiritual God, a god and demon at the pinnacle of the Domination Realm.

    Qin Ran took a quick look and saw that the blood cells stored in the blood cells were all the essence and blood of high-level domination realm gods, demons and monsters.

    This quality is not even a bit better than the ones in the Royal Treasure House!

    His eyes looked deeper.

    There, the breath of essence and blood in the blood cells became more violent and intense...

    Soon, a drop of black blood in the form of a black dragon attracted his attention.

    Black Abyss Ancient Dragon, quasi-emperor realm monster!

    Qin Ran's eyes narrowed.

    "Sure enough, there is quasi-emperor realm essence and blood."

    As he continued to look down, the look of surprise on his face became more and more intense.

    Lord Fenbao, a first-order quasi-emperor realm god and demon!

    Holy Flame Dragon Bird, a third-level quasi-emperor realm god and demon!

    Snail Emperor Dragon Python, a third-level quasi-emperor realm monster!

    The ancient return to the ruins, a second-level quasi-emperor realm god and demon!

    "Huh? There is actually blood from the Holy Flame Dragon Bird clan?"

    There was a hint of evil in the corner of Kieran's mouth.

    "If I raise a Holy Flame Dragon Bird in my body, when I transform into the Holy Flame Dragon Bird in the future, Concubine Yan's expression will definitely be wonderful, right?"

    These quasi-emperor realm gods, demons and monsters are all top bloodline, no matter which one you choose, it is a good choice.

    Qin Ran listed the blood essence and blood of the Holy Flame Dragon Bird as a temporary option. If he didn't meet a suitable one next, it would be a good idea to choose the blood essence and blood of the Holy Flame Dragon Bird.

    Maybe, we can also use this to draw Longque into our own camp...

    The aura emanating from the essence and blood of gods and demons in the quasi-emperor realm has already made people breathless.

    Beads of sweat gradually dripped from Qin Ran's forehead.

    He looked beyond the quasi-emperor realm gods and demons essence and blood, and looked into the deepest part of the bloody purgatory.

    There, there were three blood groups floating in the shape of a Zigzag.

    Each has a drop of blood inside.

    Three drops of blood flowed slowly in the blood mass, as if containing some kind of Taoist charm, trying to suck in the soul of the person.

    Qin Ran quickly looked away, breaking into a cold sweat.

    "As expected of the Yun family of the imperial clan, they actually have a collection of the essence and blood of gods and demons in the Great Emperor realm."

    After the shock, Kieran couldn't hide his excitement.

    It's true that he is the author of the novel, but when he set up the Yun Clan's Ancestral Palace, he simply described it as "profound and profound", and it was impossible to list the items inside one by one.

    These three drops of blood essence of gods and demons in the Great Emperor Realm were indeed beyond his expectation...

    The Black Qiu Heavenly Emperor, a first-order Great Emperor realm monster!

    The Lord of Nothingness, a first-level emperor-level god and demon!

    The last blood group exudes mysterious and dazzling five-color light, and its aura is much stronger than the other two blood groups.
title_en: Chapter 26 Raising Gods and Demons in the Body
